 Red Dead Redemption 2 Free Download Officially Available Until November 4 
 From Screen Rant on November 1, 2026 | OpenCritic 
 Despite its success, there is no denying that Red Dead Redemption 2 has not had as much attention as its sister series, Grand Theft Auto. After all, in between the launch of RDR2, Rockstar was working on what is now considered the most anticipated video game of all time, Grand Theft Auto VI , and, as such, the Wild West has been left somewhat in the dust.
 That being said, there are still plenty of gamers who would prefer to hop upon a horse and live out their cowboy dreams than head to Vice City, and luckily, they are able to achieve this by booting up Red Dead Online . 
 It may not have had the same attention as Grand Theft Auto Online , but with Rockstar regularly adding new and exciting content to the Red Dead Redemption 2 online component, it is always worth seeing what the game has to offer, and this November is no exception.
